newsitem.title: USA: Stanford Health Services outlook stable - Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Stanford Health Services outlook stable - Moody's.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has changed the outlook assigned to the A1 debt rating of Stanford Health Services (SHS) from negative to stable.
The outlook change is associated with approximately $123 million of bonds outstanding in the following amounts:
--Series 1990A bonds issued through the California Health Facilities Financing Authority in the outstanding amount of $7.4 million.
--Series 1993 COPs issued through ABAG Finance Authority for nonprofit corporations in the outstanding amount of $93.3 million.
--Series 1995 COPs issued through ABAG Finance Authority for nonprofit corporation in the outstanding amount of $22.4 million.
The change in the rating outlook to stable from negative is due to the following factors:
--Strong balance sheet provides added level of protection.
